//go:build browser

// The upgraded app's own drive, copied in by rastrillo's
// internal/scaffoldcheck after doctor --fix and the layout line it
// names. A menu closes on Escape only if fiesta.js runs, at the root
// and under a base path, where a script URL the line forgot to prefix
// asks the hub and fails the rig on its 404.
package upgradedapptest

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo"
	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo/basepath"
	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo/db"
	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo/harness"
	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo/live"
	"github.com/chromedp/chromedp"
	"github.com/chromedp/chromedp/kb"

	"upgradedapp/internal/upgradedapp"
)

func TestAMenuClosesOnEscape(t *testing.T) {
	rig := harness.New(t, func(origin string) http.Handler {
		mux, _ := upgraded(t, origin)
		return mux
	})
	escapeCloses(t, rig, rig.Origin+"/")
}

func TestAMenuClosesOnEscapeUnderABasePath(t *testing.T) {
	rig := harness.New(t, func(origin string) http.Handler {
		tenant := underBase(t, origin)
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(
			writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request,
		) {
			path := request.URL.Path
			if path == "/acme" || strings.HasPrefix(path, "/acme/") {
				tenant.ServeHTTP(writer, request)
				return
			}
			http.NotFound(writer, request)
		})
	})
	escapeCloses(t, rig, rig.Origin+"/acme/")
}

func upgraded(t *testing.T, origin string) (*http.ServeMux, *live.Hub) {
	t.Helper()
	logger := slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil))
	database, err := db.Open(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "app.db"), logger)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { database.Close() })
	mux, hub, err := upgradedapp.New(database, origin, logger)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return mux, hub
}

// underBase wires the app as main.go does with a base path set.
func underBase(t *testing.T, origin string) http.Handler {
	t.Helper()
	mux, hub := upgraded(t, origin)
	options := rastrillo.Options{
		Logger: slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil)),
		BasePath: basepath.Config{Origin: origin, Slug: "acme",
			DirectHost: basepath.RedirectDirect},
	}
	upgradedapp.Configure(&options, mux, hub, time.Now())
	handler, closeAll, err := rastrillo.Handler(options)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { closeAll() })
	return handler
}

func escapeCloses(t *testing.T, rig *harness.Rig, page string) {
	const menu = "details[rst-scheme]"
	rig.Run(chromedp.Navigate(page),
		chromedp.Click(chromedp.CSS(menu+" > summary")),
		chromedp.WaitVisible(chromedp.CSS(menu+"[open] button")),
		chromedp.Focus(chromedp.CSS(menu+" button")),
		chromedp.KeyEvent(kb.Escape))
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(rig.Context(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	closed := chromedp.WaitNotPresent(chromedp.CSS(menu + "[open]"))
	if err := chromedp.Do(ctx, closed); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("the menu is still open after Escape: %v", err)
	}
	if !harness.Evaluate[bool](rig, "document.activeElement === "+
		"document.querySelector('"+menu+" > summary')") {
		t.Error("Escape closed the menu but left focus off its summary")
	}
	loads := harness.Evaluate[map[string]int](rig, scriptLoads)
	if loads["fiesta.js"] != 1 {
		t.Errorf("fiesta.js loaded %d times, want once", loads["fiesta.js"])
	}
	for script, count := range loads {
		if count != 1 {
			t.Errorf("%s loaded %d times, want once", script, count)
		}
	}
}

// scriptLoads counts each script the page runs or fetches, by its name
// without the fingerprint the app's asset URLs carry: a second tag for
// the same URL is fetched once but runs twice, so tags count too.
const scriptLoads = `(() => {
	const name = (url) => new URL(url, location.href).pathname
		.split("/").pop().replace(/\.[0-9a-f]{8,}\.js$/, ".js");
	const count = (urls) => {
		const counts = {};
		for (const url of urls) {
			if (name(url).endsWith(".js")) {
				counts[name(url)] = (counts[name(url)] || 0) + 1;
			}
		}
		return counts;
	};
	const tags = count([...document.scripts].filter((script) =>
		script.src).map((script) => script.src));
	const fetches = count(performance.getEntriesByType("resource")
		.map((entry) => entry.name));
	for (const [script, times] of Object.entries(fetches)) {
		tags[script] = Math.max(tags[script] || 0, times);
	}
	return tags;
})()`
